description: A measure of which lines, branches and methods ran during the tests, which shows untested code but not whether results were checked.
A coverage tool that attaches a Java agent to the test JVM and writes an HTML, XML and CSV report in the verify phase.
A counter that records whether each side of a decision such as an if statement was executed.
Changing the code in small ways and rerunning the tests to see whether any test fails.
A code change that no test noticed, which points to a missing or weak assertion.
Compiler diagnostics enabled by Xlint, which failOnWarning can turn into build errors.
A build plugin that checks or applies a code formatter, with a check goal that fails on violations and an apply goal that rewrites files.
